description: The Instituto de Estadistica publishes counts of public non-university school centres for Spain, sourced from the national education statistics. School years are labelled by their final year. The tables distinguish education levels and explicitly exclude residences without teaching units. CSV and JSON are offered. These are statistical counts, not a geocoded inventory of individual school buildings. Published by Comunidad de Madrid / national education statistics. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. The provider lists CSV, JSON access formats. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, hazard exposure. Related catalogue records: platform-qgis. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
